works.body:
Hello!
My friend and I saw your artworks and we absolutely loved them. They are beautiful! ✨
We would really love it if you could draw our two OCs together. We have added a reference for the outfits, but you are completely free with the rest!

I also noticed that you sometimes provide versions without backgrounds. Would it be possible to have one for our illustration as well?

Here are the reference links:
Haru: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/132nmhJvqJJYjSGm8BK15ebudYDyojHql?usp=sharing
Momoha: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ZoYlKkZQGKoInj6DMHBKnw1pELb3L7PI?usp=sharing
Outfits: https://drive.google.com/file/d/15Nh_aU0al1oHt9KOLznfi4a3mXA3JpBp/view?usp=sharing

Thank you very much for your time and for your wonderful artworks!

Hello! I'm Kat!!

Hello! I would like to request an illustration of Pekoe Boo, a silly and cute ghostly raccoon vtuber. I would like her drawn in rollerblades while showing off her thighs, like in this image: 
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rZ4YYIf2csiivaRbCOgPdd-K033ldnJC?usp=sharing

I have also provided images for her character design in the reference URL below. Please feel free to choose specific details that fit your art style. Thank you for your consideration!
